name: What is customer query research for AI SEO?
description: It's analyzing customer questions and phrases for AI-powered search, focusing on natural language and user intent to improve content visibility.

mainEntity.name: What is customer query research for AI SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Customer query research for AI SEO involves understanding the questions and phrases your target audience uses when interacting with search engines and AI models. It goes beyond traditional keyword research by analyzing natural language patterns, conversational queries, and user intent. This helps identify the specific problems and needs users express, allowing businesses to create content that directly addresses these queries and improves visibility in AI-powered search environments.
